sourceReview: Five original boards visually inspected; row/column and all stable reward-card keys retained. Some legacy card crops shift to neighbouring illustrations, especially social/nature. limits: Vector fit studies are not premium-final artwork.

Expression sets remain visibly marked separate studies until proper face sources exist.
Source bitmap budget for the six-article atelier is unchanged; all-95 inline-vector DOM/GPU/peak cost needs physical measurement.
